blocks.title: Proposal: pick your idea
blocks.note:
1. Jot 3 ideas for a repeated-measures variable that could change mind-wandering, then pick one (15 min)
2. Fill in the worksheet: idea, hypotheses, conditions, measure (20 min)
3. Stats: check which worksheets show as missing on Canvas (2 min)
4. Stats: email the stats team about any practicals you missed (10 min)

blocks.title: Proposal: papers and Introduction
blocks.note:
1. Find 2 more papers that back up your idea (25 min)
2. Write the Introduction, ending with your hypotheses (25 min, keep going if it flows)

blocks.title: Proposal: Method and expected results
blocks.note:
1. Write the Method in future tense: participants, design, materials, procedure (25 min)
2. Write the expected results and why they would matter (20 min)

blocks.title: Proposal check, then start Dev Psych
blocks.note:
1. Proposal: check it against the marking criteria and tidy APA references (20 min). Don't submit yet.
2. Dev Psych: read the three essay questions and pick one (5 min)
3. Dev Psych: open the matching seminar page and note its two essential readings (5 min)
4. Dev Psych: read the first essential reading, abstract then conclusion (15 min)

blocks.title: First look at Stats report and poster
blocks.note:
1. Stats report: open Lab Report Information and read only Coding & Analysis (5 min)
2. Stats report: open the Posit Cloud project and add your candidate number (5 min)
3. Stats report: pick one scenario (10 min)
4. Poster: find which question you were given (5 min)
5. Poster: download the template and save a copy (3 min)
6. Poster: look through the annotated example (10 min)
